paragraphs.text: The Heroes' Podium is a legendary artifact on the plane of Theros . The Heroes' Podium is a podium located in Iroas 's Temple of Triumph in Akros . It is a raised stone platform with four legs that raise it slightly above the ground. The podium has carvings of warriors raising their swords together on it, an armor helmet, and two bulls facing each other. It appears to be able to generate a hologram over the top of it at one point, showing mountains. Anax , Anthousa , and Cymede once visited the podium together and viewed.

As a card, it acts as an amplifier for legendary creatures , giving them +1/+1 for each legendary creature you control other than themselves. It also has an activated ability to spend X mana to look at the top X cards of the player's library and put a legendary creature among them into their hand while the others go to the bottom of the library.
